objective: Test whether P19 HiFi4 SDPA Q partition choice changes attention outputs on identical real Q and K/V cache, and whether offset32 Q32/K32 replay matches its full-query counterpart through absolute rows32–287.
scope: Correctness-only reduced real layer0, using the first1024 natural-book token IDs, exact P19 precision config and model revision. Attention output only; no output projection/CCL/MLP or serving metric.
hypothesis: For P19 BF16 activations, BFP8 KV and HiFi4 SDPA, the fresh-path Q128/K32 attention and Q32/K32 attention could differ numerically on identical rotated Q and cached K/V. Existing resumed-prefill stage capture reports Q/K/V exact and the first non-exact stage at attention input for starts32/64; the full-resume position summary shows deterioration within the first256 rows. Neither proves Q partition caused it.

design.query_capture: Capture actual rotated layer0 Q from _qkv during a single P19 1024-token prefill; K/V are written into the real BFP8 paged cache. All arms reuse the captured Q/cache/page table.
design.same_query_assertion: Exact equality between Q[32:288] and the extracted query slice; Q and cache digests recorded; K/V cache and page table digests checked unchanged across arms.

arms.name: full_q128_k128
arms.role: secondary reference only; differs in K partition too

design.primary_isolated_comparison: full_q128_k32 vs full_q32_k32; same whole Q, absolute origin0, K32 and cache.
design.secondary_offset_comparison: full_q32_k32 vs offset_slice_q32_k32; same Q values for positions32:288 and same K32/cache/table, with the latter using absolute chunk offset32.

prior_evidence.full_resume_after_ccl_fix: 9/14 cases remain failing; no policy selection or gate relaxation.
prior_evidence.position_evidence: P19 resume-after-position-summary shows high divergence in the absolute64:96 band for start64 in both lengths; layer-0 stage capture reports Q/K/V exact and attention input first non-exact for starts32/64; starts256 remain exact through captured stages.
prior_evidence.scope: This probe examines attention arithmetic at one layer/input only; it cannot establish full-model continuation sufficiency.
